intro: Everything between a customer asking for a price and the money reaching your bank: quotations, orders, delivery, invoices and receipts. Every document starts as a draft you can change; after that, you cancel or void it instead.
start: Check your taxes in Sell › Sales › Tax, so invoices charge them correctly.
Set your discount policies, so a discount past your limit waits for an approver.
Make your first invoice, submit it and post it. The customer then owes it.
Record the payment when it comes in. The invoice shows as paid.
